editorial:
Imagine coming home after a long day and realizing your entire living space is just a single bathtub. That is exactly the kind of weird and funny situation you get into with this movie. You follow Alberto, a guy who has decided that a bathroom is the only place he wants to be. The vibe is super quirky and feels like a strange dream. You get to see how he manages his daily routine and the funny things that happen when he actually steps outside his tub to face the world. It is a simple story, but it feels fresh because it does not take itself too seriously.

What really makes this work is how the acting feels so real and awkward in the best way possible. The pacing is quick, so you never feel bored while watching Alberto's odd habits. Some might find the plot too thin, but if you like oddball comedies, you will love this.
endingExplained: At the very end, Alberto realizes that he cannot stay in the tub forever. He has a big talk with a neighbor who helps him see that the real world is not so scary. In a final twist, he decides to move into a real apartment, but he keeps the bathtub as his favorite spot to relax. He finally finds a balance between his love for the tub and living a normal life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves offbeat humor and strange characters.
